title: Playboy Magazine March 1986 Sally Field Interview How to Kiss a Girl
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, March 1986 -- Sally Field interview "from the heart," "How to Kiss a Girl," Lady D.J.s feature, a Valentine to Bunnies.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage. Please review photos carefully for exact condition.
